title: Anthropic says Claude finished two black-hole calculations.
friendlyTitle: Anthropic says Claude finished two black-hole calculations.
summary: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 solved two open problems in the theoretical physics of black holes, and posted the preprints. One result, Anthropic says, is that a sudden switch to a black hole still happens when spacetime has no definite shape. The other is an exact ceiling for the simplest version of a method used to rule out wrong theories of quantum gravity.
friendlySummary: Anthropic says Claude Fable 5.2 solved two unsolved problems in the theory of black holes, and posted the papers. One result, Anthropic says, is that a sudden change into a black hole still happens when space and time have no fixed shape. The other sets an exact limit on the simplest way of ruling out wrong theories of quantum gravity.
whyItMatters: Anthropic says a physicist checked the main results, that part of the work was checked in Lean in September, and that neither result describes our universe or has a practical use. This is the lab's account of a long research run, not a change in a tool you can open today.
